name: sepsis_sbml_eventfree_valve
description: Event-free (proto_valve) reduction of the BioGears sepsis core: the same SBML model with the per-beat E_beat event and piecewise pulOpen valve replaced by a continuous phase oscillator + per-artery valve gating. Runs via Tellurium / roadrunner, emits the same 9 shared comparison observables (SBP, DBP, MAP, HR, CO, SVR, blood volume, tissue integrity, blood pathogen), and keeps the infection events — a ~1.3x faster, per-beat-faithful (~0.2 mmHg) arm for the comparison studies. Healthy at severity 0.

severity.description: 0 none / 1 mild / 2 moderate / 3 severe (seeds tissue pathogen)

infection_start_s.description: Infection start time in seconds (applied only when severity > 0)
